svg.title: Wastewater & biogas digital twin — Water treatment
svg.desc: Water treatment. 6 equipment references and 5 declared directed connections. Static illustrative symbols; arrows do not show instantaneous flow. This selected view does not include every plant connection.
svg.text: Water treatment · declared connections · illustrative equipment symbols
